<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var DATA = JSON.parse(document.getElementById("profile-data").textContent);
  var GW = DATA.grid_w, GH = DATA.grid_h;
  var svgNS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  var win = document.getElementById("window");
  var portraitSvg = document.getElementById("portraitSvg");
  var DOT = 1.15; // dot stroke run length in viewBox units

  // inject keyframes for animations
  var styleTag = document.createElement("style");
  styleTag.textContent = 
    "@keyframes hueTravel {" +
      "0% { background-position: 0% 0%; }" +
      "100% { background-position: 300% 0%; }" +
    "}" +
    "@keyframes rowIn {" +
      "from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-8px); }" +
      "to { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }" +
    "}" +
    "@keyframes livePulseSvg {" +
      "0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }" +
      "50% { opacity: 0.25; }" +
    "}" +
    "@keyframes blinkSvg {" +
      "50% { opacity: 0; }" +
    "}";
  document.head.appendChild(styleTag);

  // ---------- helpers ----------
  function el(tag, attrs) {
    var e = document.createElementNS(svgNS, tag);
    for (var k in attrs) e.setAttribute(k, attrs[k]);
    return e;
  }

  function pathFromIndices(flat, idxList) {
    var d = "";
    for (var i = 0; i < idxList.length; i++) {
      var pi = idxList[i] * 2;
      var x = flat[pi], y = flat[pi + 1];
      d += "M" + x + "," + y + "h" + DOT;
    }
    return d;
  }

  function pathFromFlatXY(flatXY) {
    var d = "";
    for (var i = 0; i < flatXY.length; i += 2) {
      d += "M" + flatXY[i] + "," + flatXY[i + 1] + "h" + DOT;
    }
    return d;
  }

  // ---------- timeline constants (seconds) ----------
  // portrait hold 3.0s, each logo hold 2.0s, 1.3s transition between every
  // adjacent phase (portrait->logo1, logo_i->logo_i+1, ..., last logo->portrait).
  // For N logos that's (N+1) transitions: total = 3.0 + N*2.0 + (N+1)*1.3
  var T_INTRO = 3.2;
  var T_PORTRAIT = 3.0;
  var T_TRANS = 1.3;
  var T_LOGO = 2.0;
  var N_LOGO = DATA.logo_order.length;
  var T_LOOP = T_PORTRAIT + N_LOGO * T_LOGO + (N_LOGO + 1) * T_TRANS;

  function frac(t) { return +(t / T_LOOP).toFixed(6); }

  // phase boundary times (seconds from loop start)
  var bounds = [0, T_PORTRAIT]; // t0=portrait start, t1=portrait end / transition-in start
  var cursor = T_PORTRAIT + T_TRANS; // t2 = transition-in end / logo1 hold start
  bounds.push(cursor);
  for (var li = 0; li < N_LOGO; li++) {
    cursor += T_LOGO; // hold end
    bounds.push(cursor);
    cursor += T_TRANS; // transition end (to next logo, or back to portrait for the last)
    bounds.push(cursor);
  }
  // bounds = [0, t1(=portraitEnd), t2(=trans-in end/logo1 start), h1end, tr1end, h2end, tr2end, ... , hNend, trNend(=T_LOOP)]
  var KT_STATIC_END = frac(bounds[1]);   // end of portrait static hold
  var KT_OUT_END = frac(bounds[2]);      // travellers fully visible / logo1 shown
  var KT_LOGOS_END = frac(bounds[bounds.length - 2]); // end of last logo hold (start of final transition back)
  var KT_END = 1;

  // ---------- build traveller centroid (first logo in sequence) ----------
  function centroidOf(flatXY) {
    var sx = 0, sy = 0, n = flatXY.length / 2;
    for (var i = 0; i < flatXY.length; i += 2) { sx += flatXY[i]; sy += flatXY[i + 1]; }
    return [sx / n, sy / n];
  }

  var firstLogoKey = DATA.logo_order[0];
  var firstLogoCentroid = centroidOf(DATA.travellers[firstLogoKey]);

  // ---------- render portrait for a given theme ----------
  var currentTheme = "dark";
  var uptimeStart = Date.now();

  function clearSvgKeepDefs() {
    var kids = Array.prototype.slice.call(portraitSvg.childNodes);
    kids.forEach(function (k) {
      if (k.nodeName && k.nodeName.toLowerCase() === "defs") return;
      portraitSvg.removeChild(k);
    });
  }

  function buildPortrait(theme) {
    clearSvgKeepDefs();
    var mode = DATA[theme];
    var flat = mode.pts;
    var nPts = flat.length / 2;

    // ---- group indices ----
    var introGroups = [];
    for (var g = 0; g < 60; g++) introGroups.push([]);
    for (var i = 0; i < nPts; i++) introGroups[mode.intro[i]].push(i);

    var nBands = mode.centroids.length;
    var bandGroups = [];
    for (g = 0; g < nBands; g++) bandGroups.push([]);
    for (i = 0; i < nPts; i++) bandGroups[mode.band[i]].push(i);

    // ================= LOOP LAYER (persistent, drift-band animated) =================
    var loopLayer = el("g", { id: "loopLayer", opacity: "0" });
    var loopAnims = []; // collected so we can .beginElement() them in sync, since
    // SMIL begin="Ns" offsets are unreliable for elements inserted dynamically
    for (g = 0; g < nBands; g++) {
      var idxList = bandGroups[g];
      if (!idxList.length) continue;
      var d = pathFromIndices(flat, idxList);
      var cx = mode.centroids[g][0], cy = mode.centroids[g][1];
      var dx = (firstLogoCentroid[0] - cx) * 0.42;
      var dy = (firstLogoCentroid[1] - cy) * 0.42;

      var bandPath = el("path", {
        d: d,
        fill: "none",
        stroke: "url(#dotGrad)",
        "stroke-width": 1.35,
        "stroke-linecap": "square",
        "shape-rendering": "crispEdges"
      });

      var animT = el("animateTransform", {
        attributeName: "transform",
        attributeType: "XML",
        type: "translate",
        begin: "indefinite",
        dur: T_LOOP + "s",
        repeatCount: "indefinite",
        calcMode: "linear",
        keyTimes: ["0", KT_STATIC_END, KT_OUT_END, KT_LOGOS_END, KT_END].join(";"),
        values: ["0,0", "0,0", dx.toFixed(2) + "," + dy.toFixed(2), dx.toFixed(2) + "," + dy.toFixed(2), "0,0"].join(";")
      });
      var animO = el("animate", {
        attributeName: "opacity",
        begin: "indefinite",
        dur: T_LOOP + "s",
        repeatCount: "indefinite",
        calcMode: "linear",
        keyTimes: ["0", KT_STATIC_END, KT_OUT_END, KT_LOGOS_END, KT_END].join(";"),
        values: ["1", "1", "0.05", "0.05", "1"].join(";")
      });
      bandPath.appendChild(animT);
      bandPath.appendChild(animO);
      loopLayer.appendChild(bandPath);
      loopAnims.push(animT, animO);
    }
    portraitSvg.appendChild(loopLayer);

    // ================= TRAVELLERS LAYER (logo crossfade) =================
    // NOTE: animating the `d` attribute directly via SMIL across many long
    // path-data keyframes is unreliable in this rendering environment (it
    // silently freezes on the first value once the path strings get long).
    // Instead: one static-shape <path> per logo, each with its own opacity
    // crossfade timeline -- fully robust, and still gives a smooth dissolve
    // between logos with no code path that can silently fail.
    var order = DATA.logo_order;
    var travellerLayer = el("g", { id: "travellerLayer" });
    for (var logoI = 0; logoI < N_LOGO; logoI++) {
      var shapeD = pathFromFlatXY(DATA.travellers[order[logoI]]);
      var fadeInStart, fadeInEnd;
      if (logoI === 0) {
        fadeInStart = bounds[1]; fadeInEnd = bounds[2];
      } else {
        fadeInStart = bounds[3 + 2 * (logoI - 1)]; fadeInEnd = bounds[4 + 2 * (logoI - 1)];
      }
      var fadeOutStart = bounds[3 + 2 * logoI];
      var fadeOutEnd = bounds[4 + 2 * logoI];

      var oKT = [0, fadeInStart, fadeInEnd, fadeOutStart, fadeOutEnd];
      var oVals = [0, 0, 1, 1, 0];
      if (fadeOutEnd < T_LOOP - 1e-6) {
        oKT.push(T_LOOP);
        oVals.push(0);
      }

      var logoPath = el("path", {
        d: shapeD,
        fill: "none",
        stroke: "url(#dotGrad)",
        "stroke-width": 1.5,
        "stroke-linecap": "square",
        "shape-rendering": "crispEdges",
        opacity: "0"
      });
      var logoAnimO = el("animate", {
        attributeName: "opacity",
        begin: "indefinite",
        dur: T_LOOP + "s",
        repeatCount: "indefinite",
        calcMode: "linear",
        keyTimes: oKT.map(frac).join(";"),
        values: oVals.join(";")
      });
      logoPath.appendChild(logoAnimO);
      travellerLayer.appendChild(logoPath);
      loopAnims.push(logoAnimO);
    }
    portraitSvg.appendChild(travellerLayer);

    // ================= INTRO LAYER (duplicate, one-shot shimmer reveal) =================
    var introLayer = el("g", { id: "introLayer" });
    for (g = 0; g < 60; g++) {
      var gi = introGroups[g];
      if (!gi.length) continue;
      var gd = pathFromIndices(flat, gi);
      var gp = el("path", {
        d: gd,
        fill: "none",
        stroke: "url(#dotGrad)",
        "stroke-width": 1.35,
        "stroke-linecap": "square",
        "shape-rendering": "crispEdges",
        opacity: "0"
      });
      var delay = (g / 60) * 1.6;
      gp.style.transition = "opacity 0.5s ease";
      gp.style.transitionDelay = delay.toFixed(3) + "s";
      gp.style.opacity = "1";
      introLayer.appendChild(gp);
    }
    portraitSvg.appendChild(introLayer);

    // crossfade handoff: hide intro layer + reveal loop layer once shimmer completes.
    // The loop's internal SMIL animations are started here explicitly via
    // beginElement() rather than relying on a `begin="Ns"` time offset, since
    // that offset is unreliable for <animate> elements inserted dynamically
    // (they were observed starting from document-load time instead, desyncing
    // the whole loop by exactly the intro duration).
    window.clearTimeout(buildPortrait._t);
    buildPortrait._t = window.setTimeout(function () {
      loopLayer.style.transition = "opacity .35s ease";
      loopLayer.setAttribute("opacity", "1");
      introLayer.style.transition = "opacity .35s ease";
      introLayer.style.opacity = "0";
      loopAnims.forEach(function (a) {
        try { a.beginElement(); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
      });
      window.setTimeout(function () {
        if (introLayer.parentNode) introLayer.parentNode.removeChild(introLayer);
      }, 400);
    }, T_INTRO * 1000);
  }

  // ---------- theme toggle ----------
  var THEME = {
    dark: {
      app: "#04060c",
      panel: "#0A101F",
      panelB: "#0C1426",
      title: "#0B1222",
      border: "rgba(255,255,255,0.10)",
      borderSoft: "rgba(255,255,255,0.08)",
      accentA: "#7C3AED",
      accentB: "#22D3EE",
      accentC: "#10B981",
      text: "#F8FAFC",
      textDim: "#94A3B8",
      textFaint: "#475569",
      leader: "rgba(148,163,184,0.35)",
      live: "#F87171",
      glow: "rgba(34,211,238,0.35)",
      bgGlow: "rgba(34,211,238,0.10)"
    },
    light: {
      app: "#e9ebf2",
      panel: "#FBFBFE",
      panelB: "#F1F0FB",
      title: "#F2F1FA",
      border: "rgba(30,20,60,0.10)",
      borderSoft: "rgba(30,20,60,0.08)",
      accentA: "#7C3AED",
      accentB: "#0891B2",
      accentC: "#059669",
      text: "#1c1830",
      textDim: "#5b5a72",
      textFaint: "#9491ab",
      leader: "rgba(90,85,120,0.35)",
      live: "#c23b3b",
      glow: "rgba(124,58,237,0.25)",
      bgGlow: "rgba(124,58,237,0.08)"
    }
  };

  var appBody = document.getElementById("appBody");
  var titlebar = document.getElementById("titlebar");
  var titlebarCmd = document.getElementById("titlebarCmd");
  var visualCol = document.getElementById("visualCol");
  var visualLabel = document.getElementById("visualLabel");
  var visualFrame = document.getElementById("visualFrame");
  var visualCaption = document.getElementById("visualCaption");
  var themeToggle = document.getElementById("themeToggle");
  
  function setTheme(t) {
    currentTheme = t;
    var palette = THEME[t] || THEME.dark;
    
    win.setAttribute("data-theme", t);
    appBody.style.background = palette.app;
    
    win.style.background = "linear-gradient(180deg, " + palette.panel + ", " + palette.panelB + ")";
    win.style.boxShadow = "0 40px 90px -30px rgba(0,0,0,0.65)";
    
    titlebar.style.background = palette.title;
    titlebar.style.borderBottomColor = palette.border;
    titlebar.style.color = palette.textDim;
    titlebarCmd.style.color = palette.textDim;
    
    visualCol.style.background = "radial-gradient(120% 90% at 30% 0%, " + palette.bgGlow + ", transparent 60%), " + palette.panel;
    visualCol.style.borderRightColor = palette.border;
    
    visualLabel.style.color = palette.textFaint;
    var ruleLine = visualLabel.querySelector("span:last-child");
    if (ruleLine) ruleLine.style.background = palette.borderSoft;
    
    visualFrame.style.borderColor = palette.glow;
    visualFrame.style.boxShadow = "0 0 22px -4px " + palette.glow + ", inset 0 0 30px -18px rgba(124,58,237,0.5)";
    visualFrame.style.background = "linear-gradient(180deg, " + palette.bgGlow + ", transparent 40%), " + palette.panel;
    
    visualCaption.style.color = palette.textFaint;
    var captionDot = visualCaption.querySelector("span:first-child");
    if (captionDot) captionDot.style.color = palette.live;
    
    themeToggle.textContent = "MODE · " + (t === "dark" ? "DARK" : "LIGHT");
    themeToggle.style.borderColor = palette.border;
    themeToggle.style.color = palette.textDim;
    
    buildPortrait(t);
    buildRows();
  }
  
  themeToggle.addEventListener("click", function () {
    setTheme(currentTheme === "dark" ? "light" : "dark");
  });


  // ================= INFO PANEL =================
  var PROFILE = {
    subject: "SLM.ASRI",
    role: "Software Developer",
    origin: "Kekirawa, Anuradhapura, Sri Lanka",
    education: "HNDIT",
    status: "Building + Learning + Shipping",
    toolchain: "VS Code, Git, Android Studio, Figma",
    core: [
      ["Core.Lang", "Dart, Python, Java"],
      ["Core.Frontend", "Flutter"],
      ["Core.Backend", "Node.js"],
      ["Core.Database", "Firebase, MongoDB"],
      ["Core.Infra", "Vercel, Docker, Git"]
    ],
    grid: [
      ["Grid.Mail", "mohammadasri553@gmail.com", "mailto:mohammadasri553@gmail.com"],
      ["Grid.Portfolio", "coming soon", null],
      ["Grid.LinkedIn", "muhammad-asri-37a192329", "https://www.linkedin.com/in/muhammad-asri-37a192329?utm_source=share&utm_campaign=share_via&utm_content=profile&utm_medium=android_app"],
      ["Grid.GitHub", "@SLM-Asri", "https://github.com/SLM-Asri"],
      ["Grid.Facebook", "@mohammad.asri.890404", "https://www.facebook.com/mohammad.asri.890404?mibextid=ZbWKwL"]
    ]
  };

  var rowsSvg = document.getElementById("rowsSvg");
  var ROW_H = 23;
  var HEADER_SIZE = 13;
  var ROW_SIZE = 14;
  var LABEL_X = 0;
  var PANEL_W = 420; // logical width for layout math; svg scales via viewBox

  // offscreen canvas for text measurement (font must match rendered SVG font)
  var meas = document.createElement("canvas").getContext("2d");
  function textWidth(str, size, weight) {
    meas.font = (weight || 400) + " " + size + "px 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace";
    return meas.measureText(str).width;
  }

  function buildRows() {
    while (rowsSvg.firstChild) rowsSvg.removeChild(rowsSvg.firstChild);
    var rows = [];
    rows.push({ type: "header" });
    rows.push({ type: "pill", value: PROFILE.grid[0][1] });
    rows.push({ type: "gap" });
    rows.push({ type: "row", label: "Subject", value: PROFILE.subject });
    rows.push({ type: "row", label: "Role", value: PROFILE.role });
    rows.push({ type: "row", label: "Origin", value: PROFILE.origin });
    rows.push({ type: "row", label: "Education", value: PROFILE.education });
    rows.push({ type: "row", label: "Status", value: PROFILE.status });
    rows.push({ type: "row", label: "ToolChain", value: PROFILE.toolchain });
    rows.push({ type: "gap" });
    PROFILE.core.forEach(function (r) { rows.push({ type: "row", label: r[0], value: r[1] }); });
    rows.push({ type: "gap" });
    rows.push({ type: "section", label: "Contact" });
    PROFILE.grid.forEach(function (r) {
      rows.push({ type: "row", label: r[0], value: r[1], href: r[2] });
    });
    rows.push({ type: "closing" });

    var W = rowsSvg.clientWidth || PANEL_W;
    var y = 20;
    var maxValueW = W * 0.56;
    var delay = 0.4; // seconds, first row's reveal start
    var delayStep = 0.075;

    rows.forEach(function (r) {
      var rowGroup = el("g");
      rowGroup.style.animation = "rowIn 0.4s ease forwards";
      rowGroup.style.animationDelay = delay.toFixed(3) + "s";
      delay += delayStep;

      if (r.type === "gap") {
        y += 14;
        return;
      }

      if (r.type === "header") {
        var sysLabel = el("text", { x: 0, y: y, fill: THEME[currentTheme].accentB, "font-size": 13, "letter-spacing": ".1em" });
        sysLabel.textContent = "SYSTEM.INFO";
        rowGroup.appendChild(sysLabel);
        var sysLabelW = textWidth("SYSTEM.INFO", 13, 500);
        var liveStr = "\u25CF LIVE";
        var liveW = textWidth(liveStr, 12, 700);
        var hdrGapStart = sysLabelW + 10;
        var hdrGapEnd = W - liveW - 10;
        var hdrAvail = hdrGapEnd - hdrGapStart;
        if (hdrAvail > 3) {
          var hpitch = 4.4;
          var hcount = Math.max(0, Math.floor(hdrAvail / hpitch));
          var hused = hcount * hpitch;
          var hStartX = hdrGapStart + (hdrAvail - hused) / 2 + hpitch / 2;
          var hd = "";
          for (var hk = 0; hk < hcount; hk++) {
            hd += "M" + (hStartX + hk * hpitch).toFixed(1) + "," + (y - 3.6) + "h0.8";
          }
          var leaderPath = el("path", {
            d: hd, stroke: THEME[currentTheme].leader, "stroke-width": 1,
            "stroke-linecap": "round", "shape-rendering": "crispEdges", fill: "none"
          });
          rowGroup.appendChild(leaderPath);
        }
        var liveGroup = el("g");
        var liveDot = el("circle", { cx: W - liveW + 4, cy: y - 4, r: 3, fill: THEME[currentTheme].live, opacity: 1 });
        var liveText = el("text", {
          x: W, y: y, fill: THEME[currentTheme].live, "font-size": 12, "font-weight": 700, "letter-spacing": ".08em", "text-anchor": "end",
          textLength: liveW.toFixed(1), lengthAdjust: "spacingAndGlyphs"
        });
        liveText.textContent = liveStr;
        liveGroup.appendChild(liveDot);
        liveGroup.appendChild(liveText);
        rowGroup.appendChild(liveGroup);
        rowsSvg.appendChild(rowGroup);
        y += 24;
        return;
      }

      if (r.type === "pill") {
        var pillPadX = 14, pillH = 26, pillTextSize = 14;
        var pillTextW = textWidth(r.value, pillTextSize, 700);
        var pillW = pillTextW + pillPadX * 2;
        var pillY = y - 16;
        rowGroup.appendChild(el("rect", {
          x: 0, y: pillY, width: pillW.toFixed(1), height: pillH, rx: 4, fill: THEME[currentTheme].accentA
        }));
        var pillText = el("text", {
          x: pillPadX, y: pillY + pillH / 2 + 5, fill: currentTheme === "dark" ? "#E9D5FF" : "#fff", "font-size": 14, "font-weight": 700, "letter-spacing": ".02em",
          textLength: pillTextW.toFixed(1), lengthAdjust: "spacingAndGlyphs"
        });
        pillText.textContent = r.value;
        rowGroup.appendChild(pillText);
        rowsSvg.appendChild(rowGroup);
        y += pillH + 14;
        return;
      }

      if (r.type === "closing") {
        var closeText = el("text", { x: 0, y: y, fill: THEME[currentTheme].textDim, "font-size": 14 });
        var t1 = el("tspan", {});
        t1.textContent = "\u25B8 More about me & projects below in README \u2193 ";
        var t2 = el("tspan", { fill: THEME[currentTheme].accentB });
        t2.textContent = "\u2588";
        closeText.appendChild(t1);
        closeText.appendChild(t2);
        rowGroup.appendChild(closeText);
        rowsSvg.appendChild(rowGroup);
        y += ROW_H;
        return;
      }

      if (r.type === "section") {
        y += 8;
        var tag = el("text", { x: 0, y: y, fill: THEME[currentTheme].textDim, "font-size": 13, "letter-spacing": ".1em" });
        tag.textContent = "- " + r.label + " ";
        rowGroup.appendChild(tag);
        var tagW = textWidth("- " + r.label + " ", 13, 400);
        var dashAvail = W - tagW - 4;
        if (dashAvail > 3) {
          var dpitch = 7;
          var dcount = Math.max(0, Math.floor(dashAvail / dpitch));
          var dd = "";
          for (var dk = 0; dk < dcount; dk++) {
            var dx0 = tagW + dk * dpitch;
            dd += "M" + dx0.toFixed(1) + "," + (y - 4.2) + "h4";
          }
          var dashPath = el("path", {
            d: dd, stroke: THEME[currentTheme].leader, "stroke-width": 1,
            "shape-rendering": "crispEdges", fill: "none"
          });
          rowGroup.appendChild(dashPath);
        }
        rowsSvg.appendChild(rowGroup);
        y += 18;
        return;
      }

      var labelText = el("text", { x: 0, y: y, fill: THEME[currentTheme].accentB, "font-size": 14 });
      labelText.textContent = r.label;
      rowGroup.appendChild(labelText);
      var labelW = textWidth(r.label, ROW_SIZE, 400);

      var valueStr = r.value;
      var valueW = Math.min(textWidth(valueStr, ROW_SIZE, 400), maxValueW);
      var valueX = W;

      var valueGroup;
      if (r.href) {
        valueGroup = el("a");
        valueGroup.setAttributeNS("http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink", "href", r.href);
        valueGroup.setAttribute("target", "_blank");
        valueGroup.setAttribute("rel", "noopener noreferrer");
      } else {
        valueGroup = el("g", {});
      }
      var valueText = el("text", {
        x: valueX, y: y, fill: r.href ? THEME[currentTheme].accentB : THEME[currentTheme].text, "font-size": 14, "font-weight": 600,
        "text-anchor": "end",
        textLength: valueW.toFixed(1),
        lengthAdjust: "spacingAndGlyphs"
      });
      valueText.textContent = valueStr;
      valueGroup.appendChild(valueText);
      rowGroup.appendChild(valueGroup);

      // ---- dotted leader computed from label/value length, never hand-authored ----
      var gapStart = labelW + 10;
      var gapEnd = valueX - valueW - 10;
      var avail = gapEnd - gapStart;
      if (avail > 3) {
        var pitch = 4.4;
        var count = Math.max(0, Math.floor(avail / pitch));
        // center the run of dots within the available gap
        var used = count * pitch;
        var startX = gapStart + (avail - used) / 2 + pitch / 2;
        var ld = "";
        for (var k = 0; k < count; k++) {
          var lx = (startX + k * pitch).toFixed(1);
          ld += "M" + lx + "," + (y - 3.6) + "h0.8";
        }
        var leaderPath = el("path", {
          d: ld, stroke: THEME[currentTheme].leader, "stroke-width": 1,
          "stroke-linecap": "round", "shape-rendering": "crispEdges", fill: "none"
        });
        rowGroup.appendChild(leaderPath);
      }

      rowsSvg.appendChild(rowGroup);
      y += ROW_H;
    });

    rowsSvg.setAttribute("viewBox", "0 0 " + W + " " + (y + 6));
  }

  // ---------- boot ----------
  function boot() {
    buildRows();
    buildPortrait(currentTheme);
  }
  if (document.readyState === "complete" || document.readyState === "interactive") {
    setTimeout(boot, 0);
  } else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", boot);
  }
  window.addEventListener("resize", buildRows);
})();

</script>
</body>
</html>
